## Model a Person Without Flattening Identity
<a id="model-a-person"></a>

**Audience:** Developers importing contact, profile, or biography data.

Start with a person, add names and contact points, then keep authority links and display choices separate from identity.

Inspect [`gmeow:Person`](../reference/classes/gmeow-Person.md), [`gmeow:PersonName`](../reference/classes/gmeow-PersonName.md), [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../reference/classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md), [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../reference/classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md), [`gmeow:displayable`](../reference/properties/gmeow-displayable.md).
